target: AArch64 QEMU virt with PCI VirtIO sound and WAV backend
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -audiodev wav,id=sound0,path=/tmp/zeal-waterfowl-final.wav -device virtio-sound-pci,audiodev=sound0' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --probe-demo-waterfowl
checks: Launched the unchanged stock /Demo/Sound/WaterFowl.ZC; its poem and animated bird frame rendered in the graphical window.
The background SongTask produced 79380 stereo frames at 44.1 kHz (1.80 s); 155232 samples were nonzero and peak amplitude was 7000.
A key exited WaterFowl and returned to the graphical terminal; 40+2 evaluated to 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: Verifies the WaterFowl graphics loop, background Play through QEMU VirtIO sound, key exit, and terminal recovery. Live UTM and Raspberry Pi audio remain unverified.
